title: Ötzi the Iceman
summary: A man preserved in Alpine ice carried a near-pure copper axe and had 61 tattoos. He most likely bled to death after an arrow shattered his shoulder blade.
why: A frozen snapshot of everyday Copper Age technology and life.

notes.problem: Cause of death stated as fact; source: 'Currently, it is believed that [he] bled to death after the arrow shattered the scapula'.
